Bakerloo.reason: BAKERLOO LINE: Saturday 8 and Sunday 9 August, no service between Queens Park and Harrow & Wealdstone. There will also be no LIONESS LINE service between Euston and Watford Junction. Use LONDON NORTHWESTERN RAILWAY services between Euston and Harrow & Wealdstone, or SOUTHERN services, where available, between Wembley Central and Harrow & Wealdstone.
